summary: The agent's self-validation passed but the external verifier failed, revealing a gap in the production-planning skill: insufficient emphasis on cross-checking against exact task requirements (headers, on-time status format, summary file structure) and missing guidance for agricultural/harvest domain tasks. This patch updates production-planning/SKILL.md to strengthen the external verifier cross-check section, adds a summary markdown generation workflow, and creates a reference with agricultural domain examples and a stricter validation checklist.
